thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up — ACME just escalated, their per-model throughput sparklines in Console are flatlined for all models since ~08:20 UTC. They say API calls succeed but QPS graph shows zero. Screenshot attached.

alex_support: Got it, forwarding to platform. Do we have any recent exporter/label work? @lee_eng_platform can you look? :eyes:

cj_oncall: Customer reports no latency regressions, requests return 200. Sounds like a metrics key/tag mismatch rather than runtime.

lee_eng_platform: Checking deploy logs now. We rolled metric-label-normalization last night (relabeled exporter: model_id -> model). Possible mismatch. Pulling Prometheus relabel configs.

prometheus_bot: Alert: "missing_time_series_per_model_qps" triggered 1975558900 — rate(model_requests_total[5m]) by (model_id) == 0 for > 10m.

alex_support: Can we repro internally? Any dashboards reference model_id vs model? Customer Console uses per-model panels with query grouped by model, exact label matters.

lee_eng_platform: Reproduced in staging: exporter's new label is `model`. Dashboards still query `model_id`. Quick workaround: change query to `rate(model_requests_total[5m]) by (model)` or add a relabel mapping.

maria_cs: Customer asked for ETA. Can we hotfix customer dashboard without redeploy? They want data back in Console.

lee_eng_platform: Two options: 1) Patch Grafana dashboard queries in Console (runtime change) — low risk, immediate. 2) Revert exporter relabeling in agent — requires deploy, higher risk. I'm going to push a dashboard query shim for affected panels first.

cj_oncall: Please also add a compatibility relabel in Prometheus scrape config so both labels are available until customers migrate. Example relabel snippet: 
```yaml
- source_labels: [__meta_exporter_model]
  target_label: model_id
```

lee_eng_platform: Patch applied to Console dashboards and a temporary relabel inserted in staging prometheus. Verifying metrics visualization now.

prometheus_bot: Metric stream restored for grouping by model_id in staging.

maria_cs: ACME confirmed graphs repopulating after we switched queries on their Console org. They appreciate the quick turnaround.

alex_support: Filing postmortem and action items: 1) Add migration notice in release notes for label changes. 2) Add dashboards tests that validate grouping label existence. 3) Rollout plan for exporter label changes with 2-week compatibility window.

lee_eng_platform: Opening PR to add compatibility relabel rules and dashboard linting. Will include repro steps and rollback playbook.

cj_oncall: Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring. If ACME sees any billing/usage gaps we should validate tokens/rate counters but looks limited to metrics key mismatch.

maria_cs: Closing loop with customer, will send summary. :white_check_mark:
